summary: AITools/kb.py cmd_search and cmd_context were passing raw natural-language project-context text straight into an FTS5 MATCH expression. FTS5 treats '-', ':', '(', ')', '"' and '*' as query grammar (column filters, NOT, grouping, phrase, prefix), so ordinary text like 'fixed-width' raised sqlite3.OperationalError: no such column: width. Added _fts_safe_query(): every Unicode word token (incl. Georgian) is emitted as its own double-quoted literal phrase before the MATCH call, so punctuation can never be parsed as FTS5 grammar. Also added a KB_DB_PATH env override for DB_PATH so tests never open/mutate the production AITools/kb.db.

bug.trigger_query: Signal Atlas fixed-width candidate record loader pair input
bug.root_cause: entries_fts MATCH ? received the raw query string; FTS5's query parser interprets bareword-hyphen sequences as column-filter/NOT grammar rather than literal text

fix.behavior: extracts \w+ Unicode tokens (letters incl. Georgian, digits, underscore) and joins them as individually double-quoted FTS5 phrases; returns None for input with no searchable token
fix.test_isolation_addon: DB_PATH now honors KB_DB_PATH env var, defaulting to AITools/kb.db when unset

before_fix.command: python3 -c "import sqlite3; con=sqlite3.connect(':memory:'); con.execute('CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING fts5(body)'); con.execute('SELECT * FROM t WHERE t MATCH ?', ('fixed-width candidate record loader',))"

after_fix.command: KB_DB_PATH=<tmp>/kb.db python3 AITools/kb.py search 'Signal Atlas fixed-width candidate record loader pair input'
